items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for ability.
options: She can to swim very well.
items.explanation: 'Can' is invariable and takes the base verb: She can swim.

items.prompt: Choose the correct question for permission.
options: Do I can use your phone?
Can I to use your phone?
items.explanation: Permission questions put 'can' before the subject.

items.prompt: Write two words: He ___ ___ run fast, but he cannot swim.
Choose the correct sentence for obligation.
options: You must to wear a seatbelt.

items.prompt: Choose the correct meaning: You mustn't park here.
options: It is forbidden to park here.
It is possible to park here.
It is not necessary to park here.
You are able to park here.
items.explanation: 'Mustn't' expresses prohibition — something is not allowed.

items.prompt: Write one word to complete the rule: Employees ___ bring their laptops; it is required.
Choose the correct prohibition: You ___ enter the laboratory without gloves.
items.explanation: Forbidden actions use mustn't + base verb.
